attr.title: Katana ZERO
attr.desc: Experimental Android 1.1.10 compatibility port for RG35XX-H / KNULLI. Native controls and local saves; full-game, audio and clean-exit validation pending.
attr.inst: Extract katanazero.zip into Ports. Copy your Katana ZERO Netflix 1.1.10 ARM64 XAPK to ports/katanazero/katana-zero-1.1.10.xapk. Launch Katana ZERO; first-time setup is automatic. Required game file SHA-256: 016b5a72d896c87dd29a5a5f2c1d95edf482d642efe56392de08d8b9e1fc1ea1.
attr.inst_md:
**Required game file:** `katana-zero-1.1.10.xapk`

**SHA-256:**
```text
016b5a72d896c87dd29a5a5f2c1d95edf482d642efe56392de08d8b9e1fc1ea1
```

1. Download [katanazero.zip](https://github.com/elarkitechto/rg35xxh-ports/releases/latest/download/katanazero.zip).
2. Extract it into your handheld's **Ports** folder.
3. Rename your **Katana ZERO Netflix 1.1.10 ARM64 XAPK** to
   **katana-zero-1.1.10.xapk** and copy it into **ports/katanazero/**.
4. Open **Katana ZERO** from Ports. First-time setup runs automatically; wait
   for it to finish. No compiler or second setup script is needed.
